item.title: 1970 Mercedes-Benz 280SL at No Reserve
item.description: This 1970 Mercedes-Benz 280SL was refurbished under previous ownership with a repaint in red over replacement black upholstery and a black soft top. The car is powered by a fuel-injected 2.8L inline-six mated to a four-speed automatic transmission. Additional equipment includes 14″ steel wheels with covers, power steering, four-wheel disc brakes, a removable body-color hardtop, air conditioning, and a Becker Europa radio. item.title: 1950 Ford F-1 Pickup
item.description: This 1950 Ford F-1 pickup was refurbished under prior ownership, and work included repainting the exterior, refreshing the interior, fitting a shortened driveshaft and a Mustang II-style front end, and replacing the wheels and tires. The truck is powered by a 239ci flathead V8 paired with a three-speed manual transmission. item.title: 1966 Chevrolet Corvette Convertible 427
item.description: This 1966 Chevrolet Corvette convertible was refurbished under previous ownership and acquired by the seller's father-in-law in 2007. Work involved installing a replacement 427ci V8 and repaint in red. The car has a two-speed automatic transmission, a Positraction differential, a white convertible soft top, 15″ Turbine-style aluminum wheels, power-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, power steering, power windows, a cabin heater, an AM/FM radio, and retractable headlights. item.title: 1995 Jeep Wrangler Sahara 5-Speed Jurassic Park Tribute at No Reserve
item.description: This 1995 Jeep Wrangler Sahara was purchased by the seller in 2020 and subsequently refurbished and modified to represent Jeep 18 from the 1993 movie, Jurassic Park. Jeep 18 was used to transport Dr. Alan Grant, Ellie Sattler, and Ian Malcolm to the visitor center at the beginning of the movie. It wears a Sand Beige Metallic finish with red accents and Jurassic Park-themed decals over a green and tan interior. item.description: This Factory Five Racing Mk3 Roadster is powered by a 347ci stroker V8 equipped with a Holley carburetor, forged Wiseco pistons, H-beam connecting rods, a COMP Cams camshaft, and MSD ignition components. item.title: 42-Years-Owned 1969 Jaguar E-Type Series II Roadster at No Reserve
item.description: This 1969 Jaguar XKE Series II roadster was acquired by the owner's late husband in 1984 and has remained a long-term refurbishment project throughout their ownership. It is finished in black over black leather and is powered by a 4.2-liter inline-six linked with a four-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 1973 Tatra 2-603 II at No Reserve
item.description: This 1973 Tatra 2-603 II was built in Kopřivnice, Czechoslovakia, and comes from the third and final series of the model. The car is finished in white over two-tone black and red upholstery, and power comes from a rear-mounted, air-cooled 2.5L V8 paired with a column-shifted four-speed manual transaxle. item.title: John Oates’ 1960 Porsche 356B Emory Special Cabriolet
item.description: This 1960 356B left the factory as a cabriolet and was rebuilt and modified as an Emory Special cabriolet by Emory Motorsports between 2016 and 2018 for the seller, Rock and Roll Hall of Fame musician John Oates. Oates commissioned the car to celebrate his 70th birthday and took initial delivery during Rennsport Reunion IV at the Weathertech Raceway Laguna Seca. item.title: 1968 Ferrari 365 GT 2+2
item.description: This 1968 Ferrari 365 GT 2+2 is one of approximately 800 examples built over just over three years of production. Chassis 11705 was sold new through Motor S.A.S. di Carla Allegretti in Rome, Italy, and was later imported to the US in 1973. It underwent a color change from blue to red in addition to mechanical work as part of a refurbishment completed circa 2006.
